title: ElastiCache Semantic Cache with Bedrock Embeddings
description: Implement semantic caching layer on ElastiCache using Bedrock embeddings to reduce LLM call costs.

steps.action: Enable ElastiCache for Redis JSON module (configure via parameter group: loadmodule=librejson.so) and Redis Search module for vector similarity
steps.verify: redis-cli MODULE LIST shows ReJSON and search modules loaded
steps.rollback: Remove modules from parameter group, restart cluster

steps.action: Create vector index in Redis Search: FT.CREATE semantic_cache SCHEMA query_embedding VECTOR HNSW 6 TYPE FLOAT32 DIM 1024 DISTANCE_METRIC COSINE response TEXT
steps.verify: FT.INFO semantic_cache returns index with num_docs=0 and correct schema

steps.action: Implement cache-aside wrapper in application: before Bedrock call, embed query with Titan V2 and FT.SEARCH for cosine similarity > 0.95; on miss, call Bedrock and cache result
steps.verify: Cache hit rate > 30% on test query set; Bedrock API call count drops proportionally
steps.rollback: Disable semantic cache wrapper, revert to direct Bedrock calls

steps.action: Set TTL policy: EXPIRE keys after 24h (SESSION.MAXMEMORY_POLICY=allkeys-lru, maxmemory set to 80% of node memory)
steps.verify: redis-cli INFO memory shows used_memory < maxmemory; old cache entries expire correctly
